title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hypertension.

HPI
The patient is a 64-year-old male presenting today for a routine follow-up of hypertension. He reports feeling well overall and denies any recent chest pain, shortness of breath, or dizziness. He states he has been adherent to his current medication regimen and has been monitoring his blood pressure at home. He reports a consistent reading of 128/82 mmHg over the past week. He denies any side effects from his current prescriptions.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 25mg daily
Amlodipine 5mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. He appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Heart rate is 72 bpm, blood pressure is 126/80 mmHg. Lungs are clear to auscultation. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs.

Assessment
1. Hypertension: Well-controlled on current regimen.

Plan
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Patient to continue home blood pressure monitoring and return in three months for follow-up.

Problem List
1. major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate
explanations: Depression appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
